'''Kal ''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[Dagger Wing]], imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] along with the rest of the squadron after the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ondorru]] tricked them into [[Bombing of Fest|bombing]] civilian targets on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Dagger Wing volunteered to aid the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prison forces keep order, and Kal remained at the [[Republic watchtower]] while several Dagger Wing personnel accompanied Guard Lieutenant [[Brok (Belsavis)|Brok]] to secure a prisoner named [[Gouge]]. [[Havoc Squad]] soon arrived seeking the rest of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], and Kal directed the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to the labor camp where Brok and the Dagger Wing pilots were pinned down.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kal appears in the Trooper class mission "Overwhelming Force" on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
